name: Tugtainer
description: Tugtainer is a self-hosted app for automating updates of your docker containers with a web UI. It's like watchtower but with more control and a user-friendly interface.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

questions.label: Refresh token lifetime min
questions.hint: Generated automatically. Enter your own to replace it.

questions.label: Jwt secret key
questions.hint: Generated automatically. Enter your own to replace it.

questions.label: Access token lifetime min
questions.hint: Generated automatically. Enter your own to replace it.

compose:
# Service definitions for the big-bear-tugtainer application
services:
  # Service name: big-bear-tugtainer
  # The `big-bear-tugtainer` service definition
  big-bear-tugtainer:
    # Name of the container
    container_name: big-bear-tugtainer
    # Image to be used for the container
    image: quenary/tugtainer:v1.44.3@sha256:0330b152f199bea42822d489cd9eb33572c4327b624f4e8d4d1981ad3d1b16d5
    # Container restart policy
    restart: unless-stopped
    # Ports to expose from the container
    ports:
      - "${APP_PORT}:80"
    # Environment variables for the container
    environment:
      TZ: "UTC"
      LOG_LEVEL: "warning"
      JWT_SECRET_KEY: ${SECRET_JWT_SECRET_KEY}
      AGENT_SECRET: ${SECRET_JWT_SECRET_KEY}
      ACCESS_TOKEN_LIFETIME_MIN: ${SECRET_ACCESS_TOKEN_LIFETIME_MIN}
      REFRESH_TOKEN_LIFETIME_MIN: ${SECRET_REFRESH_TOKEN_LIFETIME_MIN}
      HTTPS: "FALSE"
    # Volumes to be mounted to the container
    volumes:
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/data:/tugtainer
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock
